about: VCST-6191 Phase 1: the ambiguous list with (A) and without (B) its says: excerpt, end to end. Base vc-knowledge main@f11d658 and the ranker.json published in it (verdict-1), frozen for every arm. Pickers: fresh subagents given only items.txt batches (opaque codes, ~38 items each) and PICKER brief (one-open contract), calling the real kb show (KB_SYNTHETIC=1, KB_NO_SWEEP=1, KB_PUSH_CONFIRM=1, isolated queue, nothing pushed). A1/A2/B1/B2 Sonnet-class, AH/BH Haiku-class (sensitivity only). A reliance or open is counted only if the run's own kb log shows that kb show (Haiku claimed 29 it never made; Sonnet 0). Salts: 6191-logs, 6191-w2, 6191-w3, 6191-live.
rule: B ships if, pooled over the Sonnet runs, resolved non-partial drops <= 2 points, picks precision drops <= 1 point, and controls stay >= 90%
